display_name: 固定源 IQ 表征的 DURA 多尺度 GPU 训练
description: 固定原 DURA 和仅由合法源 IQ 自监督训练的辅助编码器；独立初始化多尺度恢复修正，用源 IQ 与固定表征共同约束训练，七景冻结测试。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off; source prepare batch 32, train batch 32, ground/scoring CPU 2 threads

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 8192 source fit IDs exclude RX4/6/8 day3 and 672 source evaluation IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0 and frozen source-only self-supervised auxiliary encoder from 20261106-phase1-dura-joint-iq-ssl-source-s2026092701-r01; 117062-parameter correction independently zero-head initialized
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA provenance checked by frozen_dura; teacher summary/checkpoint fixed commit and TX/F/V/target-free source access, exact ordered 8192 fit IDs, auxiliary state strict load; no G weights inherited
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both DURA and auxiliary teacher are source-only with matching training IDs and no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-run worker and at most 3 total compute workers including others; check capacity; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: Fresh multiscale DURA correction trained against source IQ and a frozen source-only IQ representation (feature weight 0.05)
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: Fresh correction initialization 2026110612, source fit 2026110611, order 2026110613; teacher init 2026110615 and fixed E5 source state; DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: Frozen DURA 266951 parameters plus fresh correction 117062 parameters; 53424-parameter frozen source encoder only during training; 8192 IDs x 3 views, 5 epochs batch32, deterministic cached context

notes: Candidate trains correction from independently initialized zero output heads using fixed DURA context and fixed source IQ encoder; feature weight 0.05 plus original IQ and DURA guard losses.

Encoder checkpoint 20261106-phase1-dura-joint-iq-ssl-source-s2026092701-r01 was trained solely on matching source IQ, with no TX labels, F, V or target; its parameters are frozen and never used at ground inference.
The fixed source context cache was constructed and exactly verified in deterministic GPU mode; it is source-only and matched on fit IDs and data contract.
Five epochs, model seed 2026110612, fixed data seed 2026110611, order seed 2026110613, CUDA deterministic mode with slice-based linear interpolation; no target-driven selection.
Freeze final epoch and run all seven Phase1 Main split views with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, 168000 each, truth-last, regardless of source results.
Joint SSL version differs in encoder schedule and execution mode; simple outcome differences cannot be attributed solely to freezing.
